deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Supply and install modular bicycle garage with gravel roof

description.en:
The subject of the tender is the delivery and installation of 2 bicycle garage systems, each consisting of 3 lockable bicycle garages.

Supply and install a modular bicycle garage system for 3 separately lockable single garages according to DIN 79008, ADFC-certified system.

The garage must have dimensions: length 2.50m, depth 2.00m, height approx. 1.65m.

The load-bearing structure must be made of galvanized, folded steel sheet, statically designed according to relevant standards, material thickness 2mm.

Facade cladding must be made of steel sheet, surface powder-coated with universal polyester powder, color RAL 7016 anthracite grey, with corrosion protection according to C3 per DIN EN ISO 12944-2; all earth-contacting parts must be stainless steel.

The roof must be a gravel roof made of sustainable timber construction, built from inside to outside: OSB-3 board approx. 15mm, EPDM roofing membrane approx. 1.5mm, root barrier fleece, round gravel 16/32mm approx. 50mm high, with roof edge made of smooth sheet with corrosion protection C3, powder-coated like facade cladding.

Drainage must be via main and emergency drain DN50 made of plastic, internal downpipe, water outlet centered and below the support frame.

Each single garage must have a single-leaf steel door made of folded galvanized steel sheet, powder-coated like facade cladding.

Doors must be equipped with aluminum handle set with inside lever as emergency opening, door damper, and digital battery-operated locking cylinder with connection to a booking platform.

Clear door openings must be at least 0.70m wide and 1.45m high.

The design must be based on wind load zone up to 3, snow load approx. 1.1 kN/m², maintenance load approx. 1.1 kN/m².

The garage must be installed without ground anchoring on the existing water-bound path according to manufacturer's specifications, with leveling feet to compensate for slopes up to approx. 2%.

The execution must be complete including all ancillary services required for intended use.

The quantity is 2 units.

description.en: The tender includes the provision of a booking platform as specified in the document.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Deliver, install, and set up digital booking platform

description.en:
Deliver, install, and set up a digital, cloud-based booking platform exclusively usable via smartphone app (iOS/Android) with multi-level AI-based and telephone customer support, without an on-site stationary terminal.

Provide own QR code and booking instructions.

Set up the portal including consultation of the operator for provision of master data, setup of the location on the operator's server.

Open power-grid-independent, Bluetooth-based locking systems.

Provide app functions: search and location selection with interactive map view, selection of parking facilities via link or QR code.

Provide app functions: booking and management with time-staggered price overview, flexible tariff systems (e.g., pay-as-you-go, monthly and annual rentals).

Provide app functions: payment and confirmation with various payment methods (e.g., credit card, Klarna, Apple Pay, Google Pay), automatic invoicing and booking confirmation via email.

Provide app functions: notifications with reminder before expiry of booking period, information on ongoing or completed bookings.

Provide app functions: user account with registration, login, change of personal data, booking history, cancellation functions.

Provide app functions: data protection and security with GDPR-compliant server provision, encrypted data transmission.

Provide automated AI-based customer support: 24/7 customer support in 14 languages as first level support.

Provide customer support: second level support hotline.

Provide operator web portal: location and facility management with central management of all parking facilities and locations, detailed configuration of devices (e.g., technical parameters, capacities, safety functions).

Provide operator web portal: tariff and booking management with individual setting of tariff systems, rental durations and staggered prices, adjustment of booking conditions and reservation options.

Provide operator web portal: user and security management with management of users, rights and access permissions, integration of Single Sign-On (SSO) for external identity providers, GDPR-compliant data storage and regular updates of security standards.

Provide operator web portal: evaluation and reporting functions with real-time status display of all devices and statistical evaluation of occupancy rates, management of refunds and detailed billing.
description.de:
Digitale, cloudbasierte Buchungsplattform liefern, installieren und einrichten ausschließlich nutzbar per Smartphone-App (iOS / Android) und mehrstufigen KI-basierten und telefonischen Kundensupport, ohne stationären Terminal vor Ort.

Mit eigenem QR-Code und Buchungsanleitung.

Einrichtung des Portals inkl. Beratung des Betreibers zur Bereitstellung der Stammdaten, Einrichtung des Standortes auf dem Server des Betreibers

Öffnen von stromnetzunabhängiger, Bluetooth-basierter, stromnetzumabhängiger Schließsysteme

Suche und Standortwahl: interaktive Kartenansicht, Auswahl der Abstellanlagen per Link oder QR-Code.

Buchung und Verwaltung: zeitlich gestaffelte Preisübersicht, flexible Tarifsysteme (z. B. Pay-as-yougo, Monats- und Jahresmieten).

Zahlung und Bestätigung: verschiedene Zahlungsmethoden (z. B. Kreditkarte, Klarna, Apple Pay, Google Pay), automatische Rechnungsstellung und Buchungsbestätigung per E-Mail.

Benachrichtigungen: Erinnerung vor Ablauf des Buchungszeitraums, Informationen zu laufenden oder beendeten Buchungen.

Nutzerkonto: Registrierung, Login, Änderung persönlicher Daten, Buchungshistorie, Stornofunktionen.

Datenschutz und Sicherheit: DSGVO-konforme Serverbereitstellung, verschlüsselte Datenübertragung.

Automatisierter KI-basierter Kundensupport: 24/7 Kundensupport in 14 Sprachen als First Level Support.

Kundensupport: Second Level Support Hotline.

Standort- und Anlagenverwaltung: zentrale Verwaltung aller Abstellanlagen und Standorte und detaillierte Konfiguration der Geräte (z. B. technische Parameter, Kapazitäten, Sicherheitsfunktionen).

Tarif- und Buchungsmanagement: individuelle Einstellung von Tarifsystemen, Mietdauern und gestaffelten Preisen und Anpassung von Buchungsbedingungen und Reservierungsoptionen.

Nutzer- und Sicherheitsmanagement: Verwaltung der Nutzer, Rechte und Zugangsberechtigungen, Integration von Single Sign-On (SSO) für externe Identitätsprovider, DSGVO-konforme Datenhaltung und regelmäßige Updates der Sicherheitsstandards.

Auswertungs- und Reporting-Funktionen: Echtzeit-Statusanzeige aller Geräte und statistische Auswertung der Belegungsraten, Verwaltung von Rückerstattungen und detaillierten Abrechnungen.
